description: A button-like single selector for Macaron. Before selection, it shows a placeholder. On tap, it opens an anchored dropdown menu with plain-string options.

selection.description: A string-array reference used as single-select storage. Runtime uses the first valid value for rendering.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

items.description: Available options as plain strings. Item display and stored value are the same.

placeholder.description: Optional placeholder text shown before valid selection. Defaults to "Select location".

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

hasSelection.description: Optional boolean reference auto-updated by valid selection state.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.
